accessError: Could not verify owner access. The decision queue is unavailable.
approveWarning: The store will be created in production. Its floor plan and zones will be published, and it will appear in the store list. This action cannot be undone through the interface.
rejectWarning: The request will be rejected in production. The administrator can correct it and resubmit it to the owner.
commentLength: A comment is required: 3 to 1000 characters after trimming spaces.
noRepeat: Wait for the result after confirming. Repeated confirmation will be disabled.
approveBusy: Publishing the store and checking the result…
rejectBusy: Rejecting the request and checking the result…

results.approved: Request approved. The store is published.
results.rejected: Request rejected. The administrator can correct and resubmit it.
results.pending: The request still awaits a decision. The operation result is unconfirmed. Review the data; any retry must be manual.
results.changed: The request has changed. Current data is displayed; review it before making another decision.

errors.owner_not_configured: The Apex owner is not configured.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to the queue or permission to make a decision.
errors.not_found: The request was not found or is unavailable.
errors.invalid_status: A decision was already made or the status changed. Data has been refreshed.
errors.revision_conflict: Data changed. Review the refreshed request before deciding.
errors.invalid_plan: The floor plan failed server validation.
errors.already_published: The store for this request is already published. The request has been refreshed.
errors.unknown: The operation failed. Try refreshing the data.
errors.invalid_response: Could not read the server response. Refresh the data.
errors.unresolved: Could not confirm the operation result. Check the request state first; further decisions are disabled for now.
errors.plan_too_large: The floor plan exceeds the size limit.
errors.too_many_elements: The floor plan has too many elements.
errors.duplicate_element: The floor plan has duplicate element IDs.
